mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_execution WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')) AS active_jobs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM research_validation_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING','CANCEL_REQUESTED','TIMEOUT_REQUESTED')) AS active_validations, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(OCTET_LENGTH(evidence_json)),0) FROM research_validation_task) AS evidence_bytes
